cohort: 116 pregnancies in 94 women living with HIV (WLHIV) delivering at the John Radcliffe Hospital, Oxford, during 2008-2019
finding: Virological, obstetric, and perinatal outcomes of WLHIV improved between 2008 and 2019, with increased preconception diagnosis and treatment, earlier cART initiation, and a reduction in detectable viral load at delivery.
mod_finding: There was a significant decrease in both planned and actual elective Cesarean sections between 2008-2013 and 2014-2019.
